remarks: Single level beautiful spacious house situated on an over 16,000 sqft flat lot, located in the prestigious South Hills district - great and convenient location! BRAND NEW ROOF, new indoor paint, and new flooring through out the entire house. This large well-maintained 4-bedroom/4-bath house embodies gracious living and was completely remodeled between 2000-2005. The huge great room is perfect for entertaining and is highlighted with natural sunlight from the the French doors and dual skylights. Ambiance is provided by a marble-framed fireplace and a grand view of the backyard.
